On my last day at work, not only did my manager not say goodbye, our last conversation was filled with tension. I don't have any attachment to this company anymore but it still left a bad taste in my mouth.
</message>
output: I guess I wanted some kind of closure, even a small one, and instead I got this weird unfinished feeling hanging over the whole thing. It's not that I care what they think of me anymore, it's more that I wanted to leave clean and I didn't get to. Annoying that something I don't even care about can still bother me this much.
